name: 67335 · Cherryvale, KS
findings: ZIP 67335 (Cherryvale) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67335 (Cherryvale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
